name: MED_THERAPY_PROB_PROBLEM
description: This table contains information about the medication therapy problem identified for this patient.

columns.name: PROBLEM_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the medication therapy problem record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: MED_THERAPY_PROBLEM_CSN_ID
columns.description: The unique contact serial number (CSN) of the medication therapy problem contact. If you use IntraConnect, this is the Unique Contact Identifier (UCI).

columns.name: CONTACT_PAT_ENC_CSN_ID
columns.description: The unique contact serial number for the patient encounter where this edit happened. This number is unique across all patient encounters in your system. If you use IntraConnect, this is the Unique Contact Identifier (UCI).

columns.name: DOCUMENTING_USER_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the user who documented changes made on this contact.

columns.name: DOCUMENTING_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: INSTANT_OF_UPDATE_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The instant this contact was saved. This is stored in UTC time.

columns.name: MTP_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: The status category ID of the medication therapy problem.

columns.name: CONTACT_RESPONSIBLE_USER_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the responsible user at the time of the contact for this medication therapy problem.

columns.name: CONTACT_RESPONSIBLE_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: MTP_PRIORITY_LEVEL_C_NAME
columns.description: The relative priority category ID of the medication therapy problem.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: The date the medication therapy problem was identified.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The date the medication therapy problem was resolved or changed to an inactive status.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: The date that the next action is due for a medication therapy problem.

columns.name: MTP_RATIONALE_C_NAME
columns.description: The rationale category ID for this medication therapy problem.
entries: No medical indication at this time

columns.name: MTP_PROBLEM_C_NAME
columns.description: The problem type category ID for this medication therapy problem.

columns.name: MED_RELATED_NEED_MTP_TOPIC_C_NAME
columns.description: The medication related need category ID for this medication therapy problem.
